title: ChemPath
description: A computational chemistry project that models organic reaction pathways as directed weighted graphs and explores shortest-path algorithms for navigating synthesis networks.
longDescription: ChemPath is an independent computational chemistry project exploring whether organic synthesis pathways can be represented as directed weighted graphs and navigated using graph-theoretic algorithms. The current prototype implements a C++ reaction graph engine and Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm, with future work planned around chemically informed heuristics, alternative pathfinding methods, and integration with MechLang for visualization.
